name: Queen Qunilaria

facts.text: Level 72 in the script (75 on Allakhazam), an animal type. When struck she has a 25% chance to call three minions (up to four alive), and when she dies 15-22 minions pour out.
Tur Suil also holds burrowing monstrosities and tunneling horrors.
She cannot be hurt outside her tether.

story: Balor's tower stands on a crag, and the Fomorians never stopped digging under it. The diggers are not Fomorian. They are the brood of Qunilaria, a queen of burrowing things the Fomorians found in the deep rock of Hy Brasil and bound with a promise: dig toward the roots of the isle, and the king will feed you. She has dug faithfully. Her nest lies far below the tower now, a hollow full of clicking, and her young come at every blow struck against her. When she dies the nest empties all at once, every egg and grub still in her body bursting out to avenge her.
legend: She calls minions when she is hit, a few at a time, and dumps a crowd of them when she dies. Kill the small waves as they come, then stack AoE on her corpse for the last one. Do not chase her out of the nest.

aggro: The nest clicks and stirs all at once.

phases.text: Her brood claws up out of the floor.

death: The queen splits. Her brood boils out!

lairEntry: The floor is hollow. Something is digging.

phases.text: Qunilaria's nest empties in a flood!
